verdict.rationale: Autumn ships an official first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants carry out billing actions, plan management, and log investigations, so users can operate it in natural language through a connected assistant. The evidence shows no built-in natural-language interface in Autumn itself. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which MCP tools/actions are exposed and their depth, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Autumn MCP connects AI assistants to Autumn's billing, customer, plan, balance, and log tools.
Connect Autumn's MCP server to AI assistants for billing actions, plan management, and request-log investigations.
